title: Israeli ID, Company Number, IBAN & Phone Validator input
description: Paste values, one per line: ID numbers (ת.ז.), company numbers (ח.פ./ע.מ.), Israeli IBANs, phone numbers or 7-digit postcodes. Every non-blank value produces one result row and one billed event. Spaces, dashes, RTL marks and dropped leading zeros are fine.

values.title: Values to check
values.description: One value per line, e.g. "123456782", "ת.ז. 034-567-891", "IL62 0108 0000 0009 9999 999", "050-234-5678" or "6100000". With Type = auto the kind of value is detected from its shape (see the README).

type.title: Type of value
type.description: What the values are. Choose a specific type when your column is homogeneous: it gives the most precise reasons and removes the id / company ambiguity. auto detects the type per value.

rejectDummy.title: Reject placeholder numbers
rejectDummy.description: Treat numbers such as 000000000, 111111118 or 2222222 (all the same digit, or a run of consecutive digits) as invalid (reason DUMMY) even when the checksum passes. Applies to IDs, company numbers and postcodes.

normalize.title: Clean values before checking
normalize.description: On: remove spaces, dashes, RTL marks and labels such as "ת.ז.", convert Arabic-Indic digits, restore leading zeros dropped by spreadsheets (5-8 digit IDs) and accept 0 / +972 / 972 phone forms. Off: strict as-typed check (canonical form only).

maxItems.title: Maximum values per run
maxItems.description: Safety cap: only the first N values are checked and billed.
